description: This file defines a trace target implementation for logging trace events in a specific format, including initialization, termination, and various event logging functions.

methods.name: fn_init
methods.description: Initializes the trace target, setting up configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: fn_term
methods.description: Terminates the trace target, disabling tracing.

methods.name: normal_fmt_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a formatted line with timestamp and optional file:line info for logging.

methods.name: normal_io_write_fl
methods.description: Writes a formatted log line to the trace destination.

methods.name: fn_start_fl
methods.description: Logs the start of a process with command arguments.

methods.name: fn_exit_fl
methods.description: Logs process exit with elapsed time and return code.

methods.name: fn_signal
methods.description: Logs a signal received with elapsed time and signal number.

methods.name: fn_atexit
methods.description: Logs atexit event with elapsed time and code.

methods.name: maybe_append_string_va
methods.description: Appends formatted string to buffer if format is provided.

methods.name: fn_error_va_fl
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional formatted string.

methods.name: fn_printf_va_fl
methods.description: Logs formatted message with variable arguments.
